# Paper 01: Supplier Diversification and Recovery Time

## Abstract

This note studies whether supplier diversification shortens recovery time after
regional disruptions. Firms that sourced from at least three distinct regions
recovered production faster than firms concentrated in a single region.

## Findings

- Diversified supplier networks reduced average recovery time by 18 percent.
- The benefit was strongest when secondary suppliers were already qualified.
- Recovery slowed when firms had to renegotiate quality checks during a crisis.

## Keywords

supply chain, resilience, diversification, recovery
